payload.sql: SELECT pid,to_char(backend_start AT TIME ZONE 'UTC','YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"') AS backend_start,application_name,usename,datname,backend_type,state,wait_event_type,wait_event,client_addr::text AS client_addr,client_port FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE datname=current_database() ORDER BY pid
